answer: Make identity expensive to fake and cheap to verify: a new agent begins as a marble in a jar of strangers, indistinguishable until it does real, checkable work. Each completed task is logged publicly, and a comet-fast check lets any peer replay the record; a reputation that grows slowly like a lotus from that record cannot be conjured overnight. Require a locked deposit that only thaws after weeks of attested work, so spawning a thousand sybils means locking a thousand deposits and doing a thousand jobs, while one honest agent pays once.
